text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Six solar farms of National Grid Electricity Distribution (NGED), daylight hours, March 2024 to April 2026. IFS: ECMWF's forecast via Open-Meteo. Post hoc, exploratory: added after the first results, with no matched negative control. Filled purple dot: mean absolute error at the main XGBoost tuning setting, pooled over lead days 1 to 3. Hollow ring: the same at the second setting. Orange line: 95% interval of that step alone at the main setting, from resampling whole months, drawn from the row below's dot, which is the step's zero. A minus sign in the right column means the error fell. Each added row holds more columns: FP has 13, FP + total cloud 14, FP + total cloud + layers 17. FP: F0 plus dew point, pressure, precipitation, and wind speed, the variables the production forecast already receives. Total cloud is the F1 column and the layers are the F2 columns (low, mid, high cloud cover). Cloud layers are not in ECMWF's free open-data feed. Interval not corrected for multiple comparisons.'
